name: Homelab Detection Coverage
description: Techniques with a verified custom Wazuh detection rule in this lab (phase-4-detection/detection-catalog.md). Updated as each technique's rule is written and confirmed to fire on a true positive.

techniques.comment: SSH brute force against dc-01 — rules 100010 (wrong password) + 100011 (non-existent user) in local_rules.xml, if_matched_sid/frequency/same_source_ip. Verified true positive live (not just wazuh-logtest); firewall-drop active response confirmed firing. Known gap: per-type thresholds, so mixing failure types across both rules evades detection (documented in detection-catalog.md).

SYSVOL FIM escalation on dc-01 — rule 100020, scopes stock FIM rules 550/553/554 (modified/deleted/added) to /var/lib/samba/sysvol via the syscheck 'file' field, escalated to level 12. Verified true positive for add, modify (with full hash diff), and delete. No active response by design (alert-only; auto-reverting a file is riskier than blocking an IP). Untested gap: only exercised via local root on dc-01, not the more realistic remote-SMB write path (needs a second domain host).
